purpose: Prepare a bounded ReceiveOnly native qualification and a separate optional Sky gameplay study. This manifest grants no execution authority.
non_negotiable_safety: Only the public Windows SendInput API may be used for native input.
ReceiveOnly sink is an operator-controlled application and must never forward input to Sky.
Sky gameplay requires separate explicit approval from the repository owner and Leader, including a concrete song, key mapping, note location, and game conditions.
A complete SendInput insertion count is not evidence that Sky sampled a note.
Do not run real suspend/resume or interactive foreground changes until a separate native budget is approved.
Never release an old-generation obligation into a replacement window/process; preserve the obligation and fail closed if origin proof is inconclusive.

proposed_receiveonly_budget.requested_from_leader: 60 minutes maximum, one operator, one Windows x64 MSVC machine, one run only; no retries after a failed native case
proposed_receiveonly_budget.planned_sessions: Six ReceiveOnly cases, Quiet and Contention, three repetitions per case/condition; workload sessions are capped at 15 seconds, boundary cases at 60 seconds each
proposed_receiveonly_budget.estimated_active_input_time: approximately 32 minutes including lifecycle and boundary sessions
proposed_receiveonly_budget.setup_and_review_allowance: approximately 28 minutes for sink identity, workload checks, operator boundary actions, cleanup review, and evidence hashing

conditions.quiet: Stable idle desktop; record baseline CPU and clock information for 60 seconds before the session.
conditions.contention: Two normal-priority unpinned worker processes each run 5 ms active / 5 ms sleep slices; record process and per-worker CPU time; no other synthetic workload changes between arms.

deterministic_fault_matrix_offline_only.execution: Existing deterministic test-support harness; no SendInput.
deterministic_fault_matrix_offline_only.oracle: One syscall at most per attempted authored Down; no packet success or timing sample from anomalous/missing evidence; preserve raw count/status/error/QPC fields and cleanup obligation.

deterministic_fault_matrix_offline_only.execution: Existing QPC-domain deterministic tests; no wall-clock substitution.
deterministic_fault_matrix_offline_only.oracle: Boundary decisions use the same confirmed completion evidence and exact tick floors; no fabricated QPC.

deterministic_fault_matrix_offline_only.execution: Existing deterministic lifecycle/fault tests; suspend is a callback signal fixture, not OS suspend/resume.
deterministic_fault_matrix_offline_only.oracle: Terminal cause remains visible with transport/cleanup evidence; unreleased obligations fail closed.

receiveonly_native_cases.purpose: Observe public sender ordering and raw insertion outcomes with mixed and independent authored actions.
preconditions: Unlocked desktop, sink foreground, candidate SHA/tree and binary hash pinned
receiveonly_native_cases.sample_target: At least 900 scheduled 60 FPS deadlines per session; actual inserted/action counts are reported separately.
receiveonly_native_cases.success_oracle: Sink log agrees with authored ordering for every observed event; sender raw count/error and attempt evidence are complete; no unresolved release obligation.
receiveonly_native_cases.safe_abort: Issue worker Stop, wait for bounded finalization and capture cleanup result; fail-stop on the first mismatch. Do not forward any input.

receiveonly_native_cases.purpose: Exercise loss of foreground immediately before the final musical gate and verify no unauthorized musical send.
preconditions: Terminal cleanup path and stop control tested before session
receiveonly_native_cases.sample_target: Three scripted foreground-loss transitions per repetition; zero sends after gate rejection until safe re-admission.
receiveonly_native_cases.success_oracle: Focus/target evidence identifies the transition; no musical Up/Down is sent to an unverified target; verified origin-owned safety cleanup is separately accounted.
receiveonly_native_cases.safe_abort: Stop session and restore the verified originating sink only when its process identity is still live; otherwise keep obligation pending and report failure.

receiveonly_native_cases.purpose: Exercise HWND/PID/process identity or generation drift against a controlled sink and ensure no cross-owner cleanup.
preconditions: Two operator-controlled sink processes/windows with distinct identities
Both identities and target generations recorded
receiveonly_native_cases.success_oracle: Fresh final identity evidence is logged; stale owner evidence never authorizes a send or release into the replacement; old obligations remain pending on inconclusive origin proof.
receiveonly_native_cases.safe_abort: Stop; do not close/reuse an origin HWND until its cleanup result is recorded. Retain unresolved obligations in the artifact.

receiveonly_native_cases.purpose: Measure Stop/Skip and terminal release behavior while the worker is in a long wait.
preconditions: Known held-key scenario and tested Stop control
No production or watchdog policy changes
receiveonly_native_cases.sample_target: Three long-wait wake/terminal cycles per repetition.
receiveonly_native_cases.success_oracle: Wake and join are bounded; terminal trigger, sender/cleanup evidence, release obligation, and final outcome agree.
receiveonly_native_cases.safe_abort: Stop is the primary kill-switch; capture terminal state before allowing the runner to close the sink.

receiveonly_native_cases.purpose: Confirm positive origin-owned release and report all cleanup outcomes.
preconditions: A Down created a tracked obligation on the same still-live sink identity
Foreground may be lost without changing origin identity
receiveonly_native_cases.sample_target: Three verified terminal cleanups and one zero-obligation control per repetition.
receiveonly_native_cases.success_oracle: Positive safety Up is sent only after origin proof; cleanup completion is confirmed; zero obligation creates no syscall; terminal/error aggregation retains inconclusive/failure evidence.
receiveonly_native_cases.safe_abort: If identity changes or release is inconclusive, do not retarget; keep pending state and stop.

receiveonly_native_cases.purpose: Check actual Stop/Skip boundary handling; suspend remains callback-fixture-only until separately approved.
preconditions: Control event injector and cleanup verified
receiveonly_native_cases.sample_target: One Stop and one Skip boundary per repetition (three of each per condition); suspend callback behavior remains in mock suite.
receiveonly_native_cases.success_oracle: Correct terminal control cause and bounded cleanup are captured without changing suspend policy.
receiveonly_native_cases.safe_abort: Stop and fail-stop at first unexpected control result.

sky_gameplay_optional_separate_approval.budget: Proposed 20 minutes maximum, separate decision after ReceiveOnly review.
required_before_execution: Repository owner and Leader explicit approval
Expected onset oracle independent of SendInput telemetry
Operator safe abort and cleanup plan
sky_gameplay_optional_separate_approval.measurement: Report sender insertion separately from observed game reception. Use a game-visible or operator-reviewed observation oracle; missing gameplay notes cannot be inferred from SendInput telemetry.
sky_gameplay_optional_separate_approval.artifact_paths: Separate external output root; no game data or user content committed to repository.

artifact_requirements: Exact candidate SHA, tree, toolchain, Windows build, CPU, guard configuration, schedule, margin, epoch rule and binary SHA-256.
Raw QPC samples with explicit null/availability/provenance fields; never reconstruct missing timing.
Per-case sender attempt/raw count/error, owner HWND/PID/generation, release-origin proof, cleanup result and terminal trigger.
Quiet/Contention workload parameters and CPU counters; preserve failed and incomplete runs without retrying them.
Final-key/release-obligation state and output hashes; keep all generated output outside the source checkout.
execution_guard: This file is planning metadata only. Do not launch native acceptance or Sky gameplay from this manifest until the Leader grants a concrete budget.
